Scenario OAT-03/S23 — Mistral goes through the same Bedrock guardrail as Haiku

Requirements it checks:
- U6: The Mistral call goes through the same Bedrock guardrail as Haiku
- U6b: Every AI call (including Ask AI, handoff, photo reading and voice transcription) leaves from the server with the guardrail applied

Given: Code at origin/main e02167f; the UAT deployment's guardrail id / version from Tim's 3.1 build record (never read env from <dev address>)
When: Read convex/ai/providers/bedrock.ts (invoke), convex/ai/providers/index.ts (chat, vision), convex/ai/transcribe.ts and infra/stacks/aws.ts (IAM policy); take the guardrail id / version from Tim's 3.1 build record
Then: U6: primary and fallback are sent through the same invoke with the same guardrailConfig (id and version); the IAM policy denies any invocation without a guardrail; the guardrail version is pinned (not DRAFT) where UAT runs (ties to OAT-05 step 7). U6b: which calls leave without a guardrail is listed — on main photo reading (Vertex) and transcription (OpenAI) never pass through the Bedrock guardrail
Oracle: Document review with file/line evidence. U6 is judged now (TFA-94422 AC 4). The vision / transcription gap is recorded against U6b, which is gated (TFA-92568 in progress), so it reports as Blocked, not as a Fail of OAT-03 Expected Result 3. A guardrail that masks or blocks returns a normal response and never triggers the fallback (Q7); no stored record names the guardrail per call

THE ORACLE WINS. The question below only scopes this scenario to what code can decide. If the question, or its pass/fail rule, ever reads differently from the Then/Oracle above, follow the Then/Oracle, give the verdict the oracle gives, and say where they differ in openQuestions.

- (none)

- (none)

Read convex/ai/providers/bedrock.ts (invoke), convex/ai/providers/index.ts (chat, vision), convex/ai/transcribe.ts and infra/stacks/aws.ts (the guardrail resource, its exported version, the IAM policy). U6: are the Haiku primary and the Mistral fallback sent through the same invoke with the same guardrailConfig (id and version)? Does the IAM policy deny any Bedrock invocation without a guardrail? Is the guardrail version pinned: does the stack publish a guardrail version (a GuardrailVersion resource or equivalent), what does it export as the version, and what does the code send when BEDROCK_GUARDRAIL_VERSION is unset? U6b (record only, gated on TFA-92568): which AI calls leave without the Bedrock guardrail (photo reading on Vertex, OpenAI transcription, OpenAI text if selectable)? Label U6b findings half:U6b.

pass = same invoke and same guardrailConfig (id and version) for Haiku and Mistral, the IAM policy denies a Bedrock invocation without a guardrail, and the version the stack publishes and the code sends is pinned (never DRAFT)
